context_comparison.scope: Figure 9 holds a smaller eligible candidate set fixed to isolate context. This is separate from Figure 8's grouped list.
context_comparison.formula: For eligible non-exact candidates: sum 1/(60+rank) across supplied retrievers plus a context boost in [0, 0.003]; ties use stable identity. Exact names/IDs sort in a separate first tier.
context_comparison.note: Ranks and boosts are invented arithmetic inputs, not measured model quality or selected production weights. Eligibility applies before these lists. Context changes order, not the eligible set.

scenarios.event: Open search with Meta+K from a Live worksheet
scenarios.expected: Capture editor focus/selection; no SQL edit, prepare or new query submission.

scenarios.event: Search from Connections rather than Explore
scenarios.expected: Use new section context; preserve all eligible kinds unless an explicit filter narrows them.

scenarios.event: Search an exact name from a different section
scenarios.expected: Exact tier leads regardless of the section's context boost.

scenarios.event: Asynchronous semantic hits arrive during arrow-key navigation
scenarios.expected: Keep selected identity and visible ranking stable; offer fresh matches separately.

scenarios.event: Grant revoked while semantic search is pending
scenarios.expected: Clear the protected hit and suppress late labels, reasons, counts and metrics.

scenarios.event: Embedding for revision 8 finishes after revision 9
scenarios.expected: Reject stale output; never overwrite revision 9.

scenarios.event: Object deleted with pending embedding work
scenarios.expected: Hide identity immediately; late completion cannot resurrect it.

scenarios.event: Source update replayed after index restart
scenarios.expected: Apply idempotently or skip covered position; no duplicate hit.

scenarios.event: Vector index unavailable or behind lexical metadata
scenarios.expected: Serve authorized lexical results with explicit semantic availability/freshness; no claim of exhaustive matches.

scenarios.event: Selective access filter underfills approximate top-K
scenarios.expected: Bounded authorized refill or partial-coverage status; no hidden matches or false exhaustive no-match claim.

scenarios.event: Source continuation has an unrecoverable gap
scenarios.expected: Mark index coverage unavailable/old and resnapshot under its qualified contract.
Navigate to recorded work; no external retry or configuration mutation.
